address: Unit 3, 2/F, Cheong Tai Commercial Building, 60 Wing Lok St, Sheung Wan
pros: Open plan layout — minimal walls to remove
Building management allows commercial fitness use
cons: 2/F not street level — needs signage strategy
action: Call agent, ask about floor loading capacity. Visit with contractor for renovation estimate.
falsification: If floor loading below 4kPa, not suitable for heavy bag installation.
current_rent_comparison: You're likely paying HK$30-50k rent now. Mortgage would be cheaper AND building equity.

address: Unit B, 1/F, 168 Queen's Road Central, Sheung Wan
cons: Above budget at HK$6.8M — needs negotiation
action: View property. Check if seller negotiable — building age and walkup should give leverage to offer HK$6.2M.
falsification: If seller won't budge below HK$6.5M, exceeds comfortable stretch budget.

address: G/F Rear, 22 Po Yan Street, Sheung Wan
cons: Only 750 sqft — tight for a boxing gym
May have heritage restrictions on renovation
action: Only worth viewing if you can work with 750 sqft. Measure your current gym to compare.
falsification: If current gym layout needs >800 sqft minimum, this won't work regardless of price.

address: Shop C, G/F, 38 Des Voeux Road West, Sai Ying Pun
pros: Des Voeux Road — good visibility and transport
cons: HK$5.8M — within budget but less room for renovation
Check if commercial fitness use permitted in OC deed
action: Priority viewing. Check Deed of Mutual Covenant for permitted use. Get renovation quote.
falsification: If DMC restricts to retail/office only, gym use would require OC approval — adds 3-6 months delay.

address: Flat D, 12/F, Wing Fai Building, 6 Wing Fung St, Sheung Wan
cons: Older building — maintenance fees may rise
action: View this week. Two price drops signal motivated seller — room to negotiate to HK$3.5M.
falsification: If building has major structural issues flagged in recent inspection, walk away.
current_rent_comparison: Mortgage significantly cheaper than renting equivalent in Sheung Wan.

address: Flat A, 8/F, Kiu Fat Building, 115 Queen's Road West, Sheung Wan
pros: 500 sqft — more space than typical for budget
cons: May need full repaint and flooring (~HK$40k)
action: Book viewing. Compare to H001 — this is bigger but slightly more expensive.
falsification: If renovation costs exceed HK$80k, total cost pushes towards HK$5M.

address: Flat 15B, Hoi Sing Building, 7 Fung Yau St South, Yau Ma Tei
pros: 580 sqft — good space for the price
cons: Yau Ma Tei — Kowloon side, further from gym
Area less desirable than HK Island for some
action: Worth viewing if you're open to Kowloon. Price is exceptional. Negotiate to HK$2.9M.
falsification: If commute to gym exceeds 30 mins door-to-door, lifestyle cost too high.

address: Shop A, G/F, 28 Jervois Street, Sheung Wan
pros: Prime Sheung Wan side street — foot traffic from office workers
Street frontage with potential for outdoor seating
cons: Above your main budget at HK$4.2M — but below stretch
action: View urgently — price drop signals motivation. Check if F&B licence previously held for this unit.
falsification: If extraction installation is blocked by building management, F&B licence impossible.

address: Shop 2, G/F, Tung Fai Gardens, 17 Po Yan Street, Sheung Wan
pros: Po Yan Street — trendy area with gallery/cafe culture
450 sqft — good size for cafe with seating
Near PMQ — tourist and local foot traffic
cons: HK$5.5M — above core budget, within stretch
action: Worth viewing but don't overpay. Compare rental yield to area benchmark before committing.
falsification: If 3 or more coffee shops within 100m radius, saturation risk too high.

address: G/F, 55 Staunton Street, SoHo/Sheung Wan border
pros: Staunton Street — one of HK's best F&B strips
520 sqft — full cafe with kitchen potential
cons: Would need partner or investor capital
action: Flag for partner/investor matchmaking — premium asset if co-funded.
falsification: Only viable with co-investment. Solo at this price stretches too far.

address: Shop B, G/F, 88 Des Voeux Road West, Sai Ying Pun
pros: Existing tenant paying HK$22k/month — cash-flow positive from day one
6.9% gross rental yield — strong for HK
cons: Tenant could leave after lease expires
Small unit — limited upside on rent increases
action: Priority viewing. Verify tenant payment history with current owner.
falsification: If tenant has history of late payments or plans to leave, yield projection fails.

address: Office 1205, 12/F, Infinitus Plaza, 199 Des Voeux Road Central, Sheung Wan
pros: Grade B office in prime Sheung Wan tower
cons: Office vacancy 17.5% in HK — risk of void period
14 months remaining — need to re-sign soon
action: View. Calculate net yield after management fees. Ask about tenant renewal.
falsification: If tenant doesn't renew and unit sits vacant 3+ months, yield drops below break-even.

address: Flat 6A, Tai Wai Centre, Tai Wai
pros: 17% below market — bank wants to sell fast
cons: Kowloon side — further from your base
Tenant lease inherited — may not renew
Mortgagee sale = as-is condition, no warranty
action: Submit offer quickly — mortgagee listings move fast. Offer HK$3.3M.
falsification: If building inspection reveals major structural issues, bank sale 'as-is' means you absorb all risk.
